paragraphe.part1: Here, we make visible all struggles positioned on the left side of the political spectrum and fighting against all forms of oppression.
paragraphe.part2: Discover where and when struggles are organizing across French-speaking Switzerland!

paragraph.part1: Across French-speaking Switzerland, many places nurture resistance. Some can become landmarks for lost activists.
paragraph.part2: Many collectives organize around different causes. This calendar is one of the spaces where these struggles converge. Let’s stand together and support them.

paragraph.part2: , a collective whose goal is to make visible the different activist events taking place in the Lausanne region. We aim to highlight all struggles positioned on the left side of the political spectrum and fighting against all forms of oppression.
paragraph.part3: We do not align ourselves with one specific ideological stance and believe that what matters most is building convergence between struggles. By making our various events visible, we become stronger together, because it is through numbers that we will put an end to systemic oppression.

paragraph.part1: We noticed that it can sometimes be difficult to stay informed about the different events taking place in the region. Through this calendar, we want to highlight these events and make them as accessible as possible.
paragraph.part2: We believe that making activism more accessible, especially through this tool, will help our movement grow stronger and carry more weight in the ongoing material and ideological struggle.
